avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation complex formation reduces doxycycline absorption by up to 50%
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2-3 hours; take doxycycline on empty stomach

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation complex formation significantly impairs doxycycline bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Separate by 2-3 hours; avoid concurrent use within same dosing window

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.action: Administer doxycycline 2-3 hours before or after magnesium-containing products

avoid_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Chelation complex formation decreases antibiotic absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Space administration by at least 2 hours; prioritize antibiotic timing

avoid_supplements.name: Aluminum-containing antacids
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; separate by 3+ hours if necessary

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Doxycycline may reduce vitamin K-producing gut flora; supplementation may help maintain levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; supplementation may be beneficial during prolonged therapy

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Doxycycline disrupts normal flora; probiotics may help restore beneficial bacteria
caution_supplements.action: Consider during and after extended doxycycline courses; separate administration by 2+ hours

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase photosensitivity risk when combined with doxycycline
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for enhanced sun sensitivity; advise strict photoprotection

avoid_foods.name: Dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Calcium in dairy forms chelation complexes reducing doxycycline absorption by 50-60%
avoid_foods.action: Take doxycycline on empty stomach; separate dairy consumption by 2-3 hours

avoid_foods.name: Iron-fortified cereals/breads
avoid_foods.action: Avoid at time of dosing; consume 2-3 hours apart

caution_foods.name: Fatty foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May enhance doxycycline absorption slightly but can increase GI upset
caution_foods.action: Take with light food if GI intolerance occurs; preferably on empty stomach for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Acidic foods/beverages (citrus, tomatoes, vinegar)
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly enhance doxycycline absorption but increase esophageal irritation risk
caution_foods.action: Take with full glass of water; avoid taking immediately before lying down

monitoring_notes: Doxycycline should be taken on an empty stomach 1 hour before or 2 hours after food for optimal absorption; separate all chelating agents (minerals, antacids) by at least 2-3 hours. Monitor for photosensitivity reactions, especially if concurrent photosensitizing supplements/herbs used, and counsel patients on strict sun protection.
